_doc: GOLD6 picks for Diani-Kwale, 11 Oct 2026. Lanes hold <=3; no 4s were needed. Criteria in order: can't-miss for the south coast · authentic over touristic · teaches something · confirmed over unverified. Fewer places is the point. Cut venues leave data.js, both CSVs and every #venue- link. Berths and the guest list rebuilt from venues kept.

why.ali-barbours-cave: dinner in the coral cave: the one room on this coast nobody can copy
why.sails-almanara: the canvas room on the sand at Galu, fed by the reef
why.nomad-beach-bar: the strip's most complete kitchen, and the last-minute table that holds

why.shashin-ka: a Japanese family's sushi house on the beach road
why.asha-bistro: the palm-shaded beachfront bistro; Friday's BBQ

why.kinondo-kwetu: a family beach house beside the sacred forest; the grand night
why.the-maji: the adults-only house with no meal times
why.chale-island: the private island beside a kaya grove

why.mwaepe-landing: the landing you can walk to at dawn
why.shimoni-landing: the channel fish, and Kenya's first fish port beside it
why.diani-modern-market: the new covered market (May 2026) that replaced the old Ukunda one

why.moiz-swahili: the workers' biryani on Hospital Road
why.karafuu: Ukunda's nyama choma and pweza soup
why.swahili-pot: the makuti canteen at resident prices

why.leonardos: the anchor of the Italian residency; the last-minute table
why.aniellos: the neighbourhood Italian a few doors along (unverified: call)

why.pallet-cafe-diani: the deaf-staffed café on Galu sand; moved in from the cut fast-food lane
why.diani-bakehouse: German breads, the trace of the families who built the first hotels

why.ukunda-junction-vendors: the evening grills at the matatu junction

why.havana-diani: fed and watered until 01:00 every day
why.funky-monkey: the bar team ranked in Africa's lists; moved in from the cut fast-food lane

why.the-41-beach-club: the bar round a baobab, the Forty Thieves lineage
why.salty-squid: the kite crowd's table at sunset

why.charlie-claws: crab off the dugouts on Wasini since 1978
why.twiga-lodge: Tiwi's everyday address (mixed signals: called out)

lanes_dropped.fast-food: a two-venue lane of a café and a cocktail bar, both miscast as 'fast': Pallet Cafe moves to breakfast, Funky Monkey to where the residents eat; the late plate lives in Sur le pouce

cut.waterlovers-tides: fourth in the famous rooms; a resident-first dining room by its own account, not a destination
cut.non-solo-gelato: a gelato chain three months open; authentic over new, and the new-wave lane keeps two
cut.msambweni-beach-house: fourth house table; guests-only in practice and 45+ minutes south
cut.ibiza-market: fourth landing/market; the new covered market (May 2026) is where Ukunda's trade is moving, and the town walk covers the old cluster
cut.coast-dishes: fourth Swahili kitchen and unverified as trading; three confirmed kitchens carry the lane
cut.java-house-diani: a Nairobi chain; the breakfast lane keeps the three that only exist here
cut.soul-breeze-beach-club: unverified and brand-confused (the resort dropped the Bidi Badu name); two beach rooms are enough
cut.shan-e-punjab: unverified as trading, with uneven-service reports
cut.tandoori-club: fourth club; nothing verifiable beyond 2024 press
cut.go-jump-kenya: no card points to it; one skydive operator is enough
cut.gazi-boardwalk: no card points to it; condition unverified since 2020
cut.chale-boardwalk: no card points to it; no published hours or contact three months after opening
cut.camel-rides: no card points to it; an unregulated beach trade, not a place
cut.tiki-bar: Tripadvisor marks the listing closed and the newest reviews found are from 2024 (re-checked 11 Oct 2026); not safe to send a guest, so its last-minute slot goes to Havana
cut.shakatak: closed: TripAdvisor marks the listing closed and two May 2026 reviews say it has been shut for years; its own site is frozen at 2023 (re-checked 11 Oct 2026)
